📞 24/7 Support

Industries Served

At Uncut Electro-Mechanical Engineering, we provide precision electrical and mechanical engineering solutions tailored to the rigorous operational environments of South Africa's primary industrial sectors. From deep-level underground mining to high-voltage municipal power distribution, explore how our certified repair, rewind, and 24/7 breakdown services support your sector below.

Mining & MineralsPower GenerationHeavy ManufacturingMunicipal InfrastructurePetrochemical Plants

Mining & Minerals

Mining machinery operates under extreme abrasive conditions, heavy mechanical shock loads, and high humidity. We engineer ruggedized solutions and rapid repair turnarounds for high-tonnage haulage systems, underground pumps, and processing equipment to minimize costly mine downtime.

  • Heavy-Duty AC/DC Motor Rewinding & Overhauls
  • Slurry & High-Head Dewatering Pump Maintenance
  • Vibration Analysis & Thermographic Condition Monitoring
  • 24/7 Rapid On-Site Breakdown Dispatch

Power Generation

Continuous grid stability requires flawless performance from high-voltage transformers and generation assets. We collaborate with municipal grids, independent power producers, and industrial plants to maintain electrical integrity and extend equipment lifespan.

  • Medium & High Voltage Switchgear Servicing
  • Transformer Oil Purification, Rewinding & Testing
  • Generator Stator & Rotor Mechanical Overhauls
  • Protection Relay Calibration & Substation Testing

Heavy Manufacturing

Continuous manufacturing lines demand synchronized motion control and reliable motive power. Our proactive diagnostics and emergency repair capabilities protect steel mills, automotive plants, paper mills, and heavy fabrication hubs against unexpected stoppages.

  • Variable Speed Drive (VSD) & Electric Motor Alignment
  • Dynamic Shaft Balancing & Laser Alignment
  • Scheduled Plant Shutdown Maintenance Support
  • Emergency Motor & Gearbox Rebuilds

Municipal Infrastructure

Public water distribution, sewage treatment works, and regional electrical sub-transmission systems form the backbone of local services. We deliver ISO-aligned engineering services to keep public utility plants reliable and compliant.

  • Submersible & Centrifugal Pump Servicing
  • Municipal Substation Overhauls & Retrofits
  • Emergency Standby Generator Maintenance
  • Dedicated 24/7 Municipal Emergency Support

Petrochemical Plants

Processing volatile materials demands stringent safety protocols and flameproof-certified equipment standards. Our technical teams bring extensive experience working on specialized electro-mechanical machinery within hazardous refinery zones.

  • Flameproof (Ex) & Explosion-Proof Motor Servicing
  • High-Spec Class H Thermal Insulation & Analysis
  • Substation Maintenance in Hazardous Environments
  • Root Cause Failure Analysis & Reliability Engineering

Providing precision electro-mechanical engineering, 24/7 emergency breakdown support, and heavy industrial maintenance solutions to plants, mines, and utilities across South Africa.
